style.checked_requirement: Luminous cool full-colour editorial photography; three distances at right: hand-supported small pot, transmitted leaf, mature woody tree and pot; broad continuous unboxed left reading column; open bold sans Title and precise regular body.
observations: The cyan printing ground and window/floor daylight contrast with natural olive/lime leaves, warm skin and neutral textured pots.
The upper two close crops and wide lower photograph form the assigned three-distance comparison.
Greens and transmitted highlights have warm yellow components, while daylight/window shadows and type ground remain cool; no claim of a uniform cyan cast.

ratio.rounding_policy: <=0.5 pixel from requested ratio on one edge; native bytes never resized

substantive_visual.observation: Support contact, small/established plant scale and transmitted living tissue make choosing by size/light visible. Photography occupies the majority right region and expresses the content rather than ornamental leaves.
substantive_visual.content_relationship: Choosing and caring for a home plant through touch, scale and observation of light.

excluded_template.observations: The substantial three-distance photographic edit determines the whole poster rhythm and content. The unboxed continuous reading column works alongside these distinct crops; there is no subordinate tiny image/texture or empty-room dressing.

hangul_type.observations: Title has strong open sans anatomy and stable counters. Body/footer strokes and syllable proportions remain consistent; word spaces and meaning-led soft breaks are visible. All Latin and numeral groups maintain readable baselines.

information_relationship.entry_path: Market eyebrow → Title → English companion → Subtitle → whole explanation → date/hour/place → access/care → invitation/URL
information_relationship.observation: Same optical left axis, close grouping and restrained functional gaps connect explanation to practical action; no corner search.

function_contact.observation: Hand supports the small pot from below with visible contact shadow; large pot contacts the floor. Stem/branch/leaf connections and soil attachment are visible.

material_edge_finish.observations: Credible photographic leaf vein/tissue detail, mineral pot texture, warm hand surface and woody stem detail. Clean editorial crop gutters and attached shadows retain local finish.

observations.location: Upper-right left crop, approx x770–1190 y0–405
observations.observation: One palm supports the pale small pot directly below its base; the thumb rises at the left and fingers cradle the underside/right. Contact shading and a rooted plant above exposed soil make the support action legible.

observations.location: Upper-right right crop, approx x1200–1672 y0–405
observations.observation: A close backlit living leaf fills the crop; central and branching veins, transmitted yellow-green tissue and a bright edge show the light relationship.

A mature multi-branch woody houseplant emerges from soil in a large grey mineral pot. The pot rests on a lit floor with an attached shadow; foreground blur, window depth and deliberate foliage cropping distinguish the larger viewing distance.

Open dark-teal bold sans Title, a smaller eyebrow and Latin companion, a medium Subtitle, and regular body are distinct. Mature Hangul counters, proportional syllable bodies, word boundaries and stable starts are visible; text texture stays separate from photographic texture.

observations.location: Left column from paragraph to bottom URL
observations.observation: The complete four-line explanation and date/hour/place, access/care, invitation/URL groups remain readable at 720px width. Shared left starts and small functional gaps permit one continuous scan; the date is larger than body and naturally follows its ending.

The broad Title is immediately recognisable beside a photo mass spanning the full right height. Small pot/leaf crops above the larger woody plant show different scales. The photo editing is an active organising half of the poster, not a tiny ornament or empty room behind an information template.

observations.location: Crop boundaries, leaf edge, pot and hand surfaces
observations.observation: Straight white gutters separate the selected photographs; leaf veins, pot pores, hand creases, soil and woody bark are visible. No decorative botanical frame, logo, QR, watermark, numbering or additional camera print is observed.

residuals.observation: Small body/footer lines are reduced below comfortable detailed reading at the 320px overview; they are readable at the inspected 720px usage view.
1672×940 is 0.5px below the exact 16:9 height at this width, within the predeclared rounding tolerance; it is not a mathematically exact ratio.

selection_reason: The initial outcome retains the full observed copy, the continuous reading flow, substantive scale/light imagery, support contact and assigned photographic finish; no observed required defect calls for a repair.
